name: viborm
description: Type-safe ORM for PostgreSQL, MySQL, and SQLite with a Prisma-inspired API

scripts.test:coverage:policy: node scripts/run-node-safe.mjs 512 60000 scripts/coverage-policy.test.mjs && node scripts/run-node-safe.mjs 512 60000 scripts/bounded-process.test.mjs && node scripts/run-node-safe.mjs 512 60000 scripts/test-run-lock.test.mjs && node scripts/run-node-safe.mjs 512 60000 scripts/raptor3-refusal-census.test.mjs && node scripts/run-node-safe.mjs 512 60000 scripts/release-studio.test.mjs
scripts.test:package: pnpm package:build && VIBORM_PACKAGE_PART=runtime node scripts/run-vitest-safe.mjs run --workspace vitest.workspace.ts --project=package && VIBORM_PACKAGE_PART=types node scripts/run-vitest-safe.mjs run --workspace vitest.workspace.ts --project=package
scripts.db:run: docker run -d --name baseorm -p 2222:5432 -e POSTGRES_DB=baseorm -e POSTGRES_PASSWORD=password postgres

Shared connect UPDATEs and batched planning reads (2026-10-23) measure 194,142 B: reference-side connect and set targets moved by one UPDATE (updateRows), and on D1 and Neon HTTP a nested write’s planning lookups read in one read-only batch (readTogether). Limit follows the approved OD-17 measured rounding to 0.1 kB plus 0.3 kB; resource and coverage limits are unchanged. The 1.4.1 fixes (opt-in findUnique batching in its leader's context, non-null unique selectors, grouped batch-route reads, indexed target matching; 2026-10-24) measure 195.25 kB on CI's Node 22.12 build, so 194.5 kB → 195.6 kB under the same OD-17 rule. 1.5.1 (2026-10-26) measures 195,680 B: provider codes of any SQLSTATE-shaped class kept, a PostgreSQL connection lost under a statement mapped to a retryable ConnectionError, a migration failure keeping its cause's disclosure, and the client symbol migrations read diagnostics through; 195.6 kB → 196 kB under the same OD-17 rule. Measured 462 B after the schema-preserving normal $extends factory overload (69f820c11), +5 B; limit follows that measured size under OD-17. Raised 462 → 464 B by the measured +2 B of soft delete's module-level rows and methods steps, typed by name in the declaration (RBAC second review, COST-1, COST-2); limit follows that measured size under OD-17, as this row's earlier raises did. Extensions next (2026-11-01) measures 7,100 B: the entry now raises viborm's own ClientInitializationError (a marker that is not a nullable DateTime), so it is built with the root and imports the shared error chunk, which this row now counts (an application already loads it: pg + soft delete grows 209 B, with purge and purgeMany and the one-step definition); 464 B → 7.4 kB under OD-17 (measured rounded up to 0.1 kB plus 0.3 kB).

size-limit.name: pg application + permissions
size-limit.message: The pg application with viborm/permissions applied (the guide's blog policy: an actor schema, an explicit authorId predicate and an actor condition, $as per request, one read, one create, one can): measured 184,652 B at the M2 exit (wave 5), +5,534 B over the pg application row (the entry's compiler with placement, moves, acyclic relations and evidence, can/assert through $access). First measured 181,404 B at c7d1951cd (U10). Limit = measured rounded up to 0.1 kB + 0.3 kB (OD-17). Raised 185 → 185.8 kB by the measured +488 B (185.49 kB) of the independent review's fixes (2026-10-16): refusals of unknown policy, model and field-entry keys, mistyped declaration keys, keyLimit models and undeclared ceilings; can/assert over findUnique with one ask per level; the prover's structural equality and R6 safeguard (OD-17). Comma-separated action keys measure 185,861 B (2026-10-16): normalized bindings and rejection of empty, repeated, overlapping and reserved members. Limit 186.2 kB follows the same rounding plus 0.3 kB rule (OD-17). CRUD permissions and complementary credential scopes measure 186,347 B (2026-10-17); limit 186.7 kB follows the approved measured rounding plus 0.3 kB rule (OD-17). Conditional parameter-read preservation and the permissions rename measure 187,685 B (2026-10-17), +1,338 B from the last recorded application measurement; limit 188 kB follows OD-17 rounding plus 0.3 kB. The simplifier preserves missing/null and whole-list refusals while retaining compact inherited predicates. Raised by the second review's fixes (2026-10-17: typed VALUES rows for judged inserts, caller-text runs in shared-body keys, isolated nesting levels on D1), measured 188.19 kB after the permissions rename; limit = measured rounded up to 0.1 kB + 0.3 kB (OD-17). Actor admission and polymorphic projection consistency (2026-10-18) measure 189,787 B: required native actor validation, per-grant availability and variant projection admission. Limit follows OD-17 rounding to 0.1 kB plus 0.3 kB. Permissions application reuse (2026-10-18) measures 190,939 B: private policy-definition caching, immutable row admission and control-reference reuse. Limit follows the approved OD-17 measured rounding to 0.1 kB plus 0.3 kB; resource and coverage limits are unchanged. Cold compilation sharing (2026-10-18) measures 191,498 B: compilation-local structural keys and shared guards in the policy simplifier, and admission that parses and walks each shared sub-predicate once. Limit follows the approved OD-17 measured rounding to 0.1 kB plus 0.3 kB; resource and coverage limits are unchanged. 1.3.2 (2026-10-19) measures 196,216 B: per-model compilation (the policy compiler, the declaration snapshot, frozen lazy entries), $exists and { $row, up } in rules, and the refusal of field references and empty actor conditions. Limit follows the approved OD-17 measured rounding to 0.1 kB plus 0.3 kB; resource and coverage limits are unchanged. 1.3.3 (2026-10-19) measures 196,634 B: to-one relation ordering through one LEFT JOIN, the mixed-direction cursor bound, outer-reference chains joined into one EXISTS, merged quantifiers, shared bodies in located lookups, the NOT MATERIALIZED spelling, the upsert refusal's cause; schema validation rules no longer kept (-1.65 kB). Limit follows the approved OD-17 measured rounding to 0.1 kB plus 0.3 kB; resource and coverage limits are unchanged. 1.4.0 (2026-10-20) measures 201,329 B: writes answering relation projections in their own statement, findUnique batching (+1.75 kB), the undefined bulk-where refusal and $extends result computed fields (+2.2 kB), SQLite AS MATERIALIZED nested bodies, single-window distinct, junction-joined many-to-many filters on SQLite. Limit follows the approved OD-17 measured rounding to 0.1 kB plus 0.3 kB; resource and coverage limits are unchanged. Neki relation budget (2026-10-21) measures 205,450 B: recursive walks carrying the columns their next hop reads, and past 256 relations a statement's repeated walks as one reaching set and rows joined to the key sets they test, one-column sets held as PostgreSQL arrays (relationsPerStatement: stated, or 256 where a PostgreSQL driver reads Neki from its first connection's startup or first refusal; D1 256). Limit follows the approved OD-17 measured rounding to 0.1 kB plus 0.3 kB; resource and coverage limits are unchanged. Nested-write round trips (2026-10-22) measures 206,535 B: a nested write answering its result out of its root statement, a nested root update locating its row in its own UPDATE, and an upsert probe holding the row it finds on PostgreSQL (locksMissingKeys). Limit follows the approved OD-17 measured rounding to 0.1 kB plus 0.3 kB; resource and coverage limits are unchanged. To-many targets read together (2026-10-22) measures 207,162 B: a to-many connect or set reading its targets in one statement and linking them in one INSERT (Selection.rows, linkMany). Limit follows the approved OD-17 measured rounding to 0.1 kB plus 0.3 kB; resource and coverage limits are unchanged. Shared connect UPDATEs and batched planning reads (2026-10-23) measure 208,063 B: reference-side connect and set targets moved by one UPDATE (updateRows), and on D1 and Neon HTTP a nested write’s planning lookups read in one read-only batch (readTogether). The 1.4.1 fixes (opt-in findUnique batching in its leader's context, non-null unique selectors, grouped batch-route reads, indexed target matching; 2026-10-24) measure 209.17 kB on CI's Node 22.12 build, so 208.4 kB → 209.5 kB under the same OD-17 rule. Native insensitive matching (2026-10-29: ILIKE/LOWER folds, a client-escaped PostgreSQL pattern, foldable JSON-path strings) measures 209.56 kB on CI, so 209.5 kB → 209.9 kB under the same OD-17 rule.
